title: Referrer-Policy sends full URLs to cross-origin destinations
description: The policy no-referrer-when-downgrade sends the full referrer URL to every destination that is at least as secure as the current page. It strips the referrer only on a downgrade, so an https page still hands full paths and query strings to unrelated https sites. DPK-DAST-068 covers unsafe-url, which sends the full URL on every request; this rule covers the narrower default that leaks on every non-downgrade hop.
remediation: Use strict-origin-when-cross-origin or same-origin. Both keep the full URL on same-origin navigation and send only the origin, or nothing, across origins.
limitation: Header value check on one response. It cannot see which URLs carry sensitive query strings or whether a destination is third-party.
